sections.text_helper: Section 73.4.6 "Battery charging detection" in chapter 73 (USB on-the-go high-speed (OTG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3764.
sections.section_content:
Support is available for the USB battery charging specification (v1.2).
The OTG includes the necessary circuits to enable battery charging detection (portable
device).
There is also a possibility to behave as a charging data port (the port advertises 1.5A
available on it's VBUS pin).
Various fields control this functions and are implemented in register OTG_GCCFG.
